description: Maracas Bay is possibly the most popular beach in Trinidad. It is located on the mountainous north coast, approximately 30-minutes from the capital city, Port-of-Spain. Visitors enjoy the panoramic vistas of the palm-fringed beach with its energetic waves. Listed opening hours: 6 am to 6 pm. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
